profile_fields.title: Deep Learning for Scientific Document Understanding: A Comprehensive Survey
profile_fields.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of deep learning approaches for scientific document understanding. We review recent advances in layout analysis, text extraction, and semantic understanding of academic papers. Our analysis covers transformer-based models, graph neural networks, and multi-modal approaches that combine vision and language understanding.
